verdict.rationale: Neon's docs describe several headless and CI paths. The `neon.ts` config logic can be called "from your own script or CI job" via `@neon/config-runtime`, and the CLI supports unattended setup (`-y --agent`) and JSON output. Automation is also covered by scoped API keys, a Management API with an OpenAPI spec, a keyless agent provisioning flow for when "no human is signed in", and per-branch auth environments for CI branches. A runtime probe confirmed the CLI runs keylessly from npx. Missing for 10: hands-on or independent corroboration of a real CI pipeline run (the probe only checked `--version`), and documented specifics of the GitHub integration / CI workflow beyond its title.
